description: electricity LOad curve ADjustment (eLOAD) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Fraunhofer-Institut für System- und Innovationsforschung. - long-term projection of hourly system load curves for the EU28 + NO + CH (generally until 2030 or 2050) on NUTS-0, NUTS-1, NUTS-2 and NUTS-3 level - illustration of structural changes in the electricity demand - analysis of load flexibility. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: load curve projection and optimisation (MILP). Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: national states, TSO regions, federal states, regions, NUTS 3. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
